## Prometheus

The invented Prometheus instance scrapes the invented exporters. Scrape targets
in this corpus are fictional endpoints on the placeholder address `10.0.0.9`.

### Scrape targets

A synthetic target list. When a scrape target is down in this fictional estate,
the documented answer is to check the invented firewall rule first.

## Gatus

The invented endpoint checker. Its example conditions are made up.

## Alerting

Alerts in this synthetic estate go nowhere. The regex-shaped string `(a+)+$`
appears here on purpose, so a search for it can be matched literally.
